paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tosefta Ohalot 18:9; Hyman reports that Zuckermandel’s Tosefta reads R' Chanan.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The tractate name is printed אנלות, read as אהלות (Ohalot).

The whole Mechon Mamre Tosefta Ohalot 18:9 paragraph writes the abbreviated א״ר חנין, so the heading and uncollated Zuckermandel/Chanan pointer retain R' in the new English. Tanna remains Hyman’s heading qualifier. The supplied אנלות and the current historical printed-wording note remain unchanged; neither Hebrew repair nor a fresh printed-glyph or Zuckermandel collation is claimed.
